​A #vintagechronograph of true beauty on the wrist today. 1965 Enicar Sherpa Graph Mk3, powered by the legendary Valjoux 72. ⏱️🏎️

​This isn't just a timepiece; it’s a portal straight to the golden age of 1960s motorsports. The Sherpa Graph Mk3 is widely regarded as a grail for the true connoisseur, but its ultimate bragging right lies in its pedigree. This iconic reference famously adorned the wrist of arguably the greatest driver of the period, the legendary Jim Clark.

​They simply don't make them like this anymore.

#enicar #enicarwatches ​#enicarsherpa #watchcollection

FINDS... ✈️✈️✈️ 1974 Enicar Sherpa Super Jet, NOS condition. We believe this was the last (and most colourful) version of Super Jet released by Enicar before their demise. Utilising a revised case (43x44mm) with its combination of brushed and polished surfaces and short lugs. The 24 hour bezel has a vibrant yellow (night track), the minute markers with lovely orange tails and then there's that unique chequered GMT hand! All wonderful details. Collector's grade. ✈️✈️✈️
